body:
Want a **Nether Star** without fighting a **Wither?** Well now **_YOU_** can with this **MOD!** it will allow you to craft a _nether star, a dragon egg and etc.._ This mod will be _updated_ with _more recipes_! Thanks for supporting us! This Mod is made using **MCreator**. Please Comment every Recipe you Want Us to add! We Also Update **Frequently**! 

![OurLogo_Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bd1ab7df8b967be8b8b87df5d5a96ec96b4e8d4.png)
 
### Created With MCreator And HiddenYT

If You want any Recipe added, Feel Free to comment! We Check every friday or any other day!
If You want to support us! Join Our Discord, makesure to be 13+

# Q & A !
## Q: What Does this Mod Do?
A: It Adds Recipes to Items without Recipes to Make some mods like _Create_ to be Fully Automatic

## Q: Why Would we Users, Download this mod?
A: This mod is Great for Recipe Mods and it Helps to Automate Some Items

## Q: What Mods are Compatible?
A: Any Mods! Best Suited for _JEI_

## Q: What Mods Require this mod?
A: Any Mods That feature "More And Extra" then What its Adding, Mostly My Mods.

## Q: When do You Update?
A: We Update Frequently or Sometimes, We Update when a New Recipe is needed or a Bug Fix.

## Q: What Mod Loader does It Currently Support?
A: Only Forge.. For now.
